decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core two-component coating competence for heavy-duty corrosion protection, so it fits its harsh-conditions positioning; only being mentioned on the website suggests modest visibility, but industry growth and slack give no pressing shortfall to trigger dropping it.

The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established construction-repair offer and has a dedicated page, which signals satisfactory performance and low carrying cost, giving no reason for problemistic search.
A multi-model transfer pump line builds on core material-conveying know-how and in-house manufacturing, and in a growing industry its results likely meet aspirations, so it is retained.

Fire protection flow monitoring is a more peripheral, digitalization-oriented addition with uncertain results, but it has a dedicated page and matches the firm's digital strategy, and available slack lets the firm carry it for now.
